name: Default
shortDescription: Live media server and proxy that pulls RTSP, RTMP, SRT or HLS sources and serves them to browsers over password-protected HLS, with optional recording to disk.

alerts.message: Only HLS playback is routed through the web domain. RTSP, RTMP, SRT, WebRTC and Media-over-QUIC ports are not published, so streams cannot be pushed from outside: add each source to pull under paths in mediamtx.yml and open https://<domain>/<name>/.
Watching a stream asks for credentials: use the MEDIAMTX_USER and MEDIAMTX_PASSWORD environment values. The root URL has no page of its own and redirects to the MediaMTX proxy guide.
